steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(11); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: pose-exterior-gable
steps.eval: (() => { const t=window.__three; if(!t) return 'no __three'; const cam=t.camera; cam.position.set(16.2, 7.0, 24.0); if(t.controls){ t.controls.target.set(3.2, 4.2, 7.0); t.controls.update(); } cam.updateMatrixWorld(); window.__store.getState().markDirty?.(); return [cam.position.x, cam.position.y, cam.position.z]; })()

steps.name: pose-exterior-hip
steps.eval: (() => { const t=window.__three; const cam=t.camera; cam.position.set(16.2, 7.0, 24.0); if(t.controls){ t.controls.target.set(3.2, 4.2, 7.0); t.controls.update(); } cam.updateMatrixWorld(); window.__store.getState().markDirty?.(); })()

steps.name: back-to-gable-add-dormers
steps.eval: (() => { const fp=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; window.__store.getState().updateFloorPlanMeta({ roof: { ...fp.roof, style: 'gable', ridgeAxis: 'z', dormers: [ { wallSide: 'E', offset: 3.5, width: 1.6 }, { wallSide: 'E', offset: 8.5, width: 1.6 } ] } }); })()

steps.name: pose-exterior-dormers
steps.eval: (() => { const t=window.__three; const cam=t.camera; cam.position.set(17.5, 7.5, 8.0); if(t.controls){ t.controls.target.set(3.2, 4.2, 7.0); t.controls.update(); } cam.updateMatrixWorld(); window.__store.getState().markDirty?.(); })()
